answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, reduced by each unverified claim, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The signal of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. A pigment of per-task receipts records who did what, and the jetty of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
